  // Sync language detection before paint to avoid a flash.
  // Order: ?lang= > localStorage > timezone (Europe/Helsinki → fi) > en.
  (function () {
    try {
      var params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
      var lang = null;
      var qs = params.get('lang');
      if (qs === 'fi' || qs === 'en') lang = qs;
      if (!lang) { var s = localStorage.getItem('lac-lang'); if (s === 'fi' || s === 'en') lang = s; }
      if (!lang) { var tz = (Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone) || ''; if (tz === 'Europe/Helsinki') lang = 'fi'; }
      document.documentElement.lang = (lang === 'fi') ? 'fi' : 'en';
    } catch (e) { document.documentElement.lang = 'en'; }
  })();
</script>
<style>
  /* ── Fonts (self-hosted, per design.md marketing plane) ── */
  @font-face { font-family: 'Manrope Variable'; font-style: normal; font-weight: 200 800; font-display: swap;
    src: url('/assets/fonts/manrope-latin-wght-normal.woff2') format('woff2'); }
  @font-face { font-family: 'Newsreader Variable'; font-style: normal; font-weight: 200 800; font-display: swap;
    src: url('/assets/fonts/newsreader-latin-wght-normal.woff2') format('woff2'); }
  @font-face { font-family: 'Newsreader Variable'; font-style: italic; font-weight: 200 800; font-display: swap;
    src: url('/assets/fonts/newsreader-latin-wght-italic.woff2') format('woff2'); }
  @font-face { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono'; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; font-display: swap;
    src: url('/assets/fonts/ibm-plex-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2') format('woff2'); }

  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  :root {
    --paper:        #ffffff;
    --ink:          #191913;
    /* Björn tile hues */
    --tile-hi:      #e2e7ff;
    --tile-mid:     #b5c2ff;
    --tile-deep:    #91a2f8;
    --tile-glow:    71, 92, 230;
    --ink-soft:     #606077;
    --ink-tertiary: #a1a1a6;
    --line:         rgba(17,17,17,0.10);
    --line-dot:     rgba(17,17,17,0.26);
    --accent:       #a8bdff;
    --accent-deep:  #4a63d4;
    --accent-tint:  rgba(168,189,255,0.20);
    --field:        #2e46ff; /* the '+' dust marks and the chat spinner */
    --shadow-card:  0 1px 2px rgba(23,26,31,.05), 0 8px 24px rgba(23,26,31,.06);
    --card-rule: rgba(17,17,17,0.16);
    --r-xl: 34px; --r-lg: 28px; --r-md: 22px; --r-sm: 14px; --r-pill: 999px;
    --ease:   cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    --spring: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
    --maxw: 1280px;
    --page-pad: clamp(24px, 4vw, 64px);
    --font-body:  'Manrope Variable', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    --font-serif: 'Newsreader Variable', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
    --font-mono:  'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace;
    --rail-x: 50%;
    --roto-step: 78px;
  }

  @supports (corner-shape: superellipse(1)) {
    .squircle { corner-shape: superellipse(1.8); }
    .pill     { corner-shape: superellipse(2.2); }
  }

  html { font-size: 16px; scroll-behavior: smooth; scroll-padding-top: 96px; -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; overflow-x: clip; }
  body {
    background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink);
    font-family: var(--font-body);
    font-weight: 430; letter-spacing: -0.012em; line-height: 1.5;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
    min-height: 100vh; overflow-x: hidden;
  }
  a { color: inherit; }
  img { max-width: 100%; }
  .wrap { max-width: var(--maxw); margin: 0 auto; padding-inline: var(--page-pad); }
  .mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); }
  .sr-only {
    position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px;
    overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0;
  }

  /* i18n */
  .lang-fi { display: none; }
  html[lang="fi"] .lang-en { display: none; }
  html[lang="fi"] .lang-fi { display: revert; }

  :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-deep); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }
  .contact-panel :focus-visible { outline-color: #fff; }

  /* ── Number stardust: fixed full-page depth field behind everything ── */
  #dust { position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none; }
  /* frosted band under the text column: the dust can run darker while the
     reading path stays calm; edges feather so it never reads as a box */
  .text-veil {
    position: fixed; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 50%; z-index: -1;
    width: min(1040px, 94vw); transform: translateX(-50%);
    pointer-events: none;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
    backdrop-filter: blur(1px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(1px);
    -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #000 16%, #000 84%, transparent);
    mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #000 16%, #000 84%, transparent);
  }
  @media (max-width: 760px) {
    /* small screens: calm the scenery under the text without erasing it */
    .text-veil {
      width: 100vw;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
      backdrop-filter: blur(1px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(1px);
      -webkit-mask-image: none;
      mask-image: none;
    }
  }

  /* ── Liquid glass (marketing recipe) ── */
  .glass {
    position: relative;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
    backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(180%);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(180%);
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9) inset, 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(255,255,255,0.6) inset, 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  }

  /* ── Y2K liquid-glass bubble cards: convex shell, rim light, ink text ── */
  .glass-card {
    position: relative;
    background:
      radial-gradient(130% 115% at 26% 16%,
        rgba(255,255,255,0.7), rgba(255,255,255,0.22) 52%, rgba(255,255,255,0.48) 100%),
      rgba(168, 189, 255, 0.18);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(190%);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(190%);
    border: none;
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 14px 22px -14px rgba(255,255,255,0.95),
      inset 0 -14px 26px -16px rgba(23,26,31,0.24),
      inset 8px 0 18px -14px rgba(255,255,255,0.7),
      inset -10px 0 20px -16px rgba(23,26,31,0.12),
      0 2px 4px rgba(23,26,31,0.08),
      0 30px 64px -26px rgba(23,26,31,0.32);
  }
  .glass-card::before { /* curved specular blobs under the text, over the frost */
    content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1;
    border-radius: inherit; pointer-events: none;
    background:
      radial-gradient(52% 30% at 24% 5%, rgba(255,255,255,0.95), rgba(255,255,255,0) 70%),
      radial-gradient(36% 22% at 80% 97%, rgba(255,255,255,0.55), rgba(255,255,255,0) 72%),
      linear-gradient(112deg, rgba(255,255,255,0) 44%, rgba(255,255,255,0.34) 51%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 60%);
  }
  .glass-card::after { /* the bubble rim: bright where the light hits */
    content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; padding: 1.5px;
    border-radius: inherit; pointer-events: none;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg,
      rgba(255,255,255,1) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.2) 28%,
      rgba(120,126,150,0.18) 52%, rgba(255,255,255,0.85) 100%);
    -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
    -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
    mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
    mask-composite: exclude;
  }

  /* ── Buttons (canonical .btn-dark / .btn-ghost) ── */
  .btn {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px;
    appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none;
    font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 560; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid transparent;
    padding: 11px 20px; border-radius: 12px;
    transition: transform 0.2s var(--ease), background 0.2s var(--ease), box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease), border-color 0.2s var(--ease), color 0.2s var(--ease); white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .btn-dark {
    background: var(--ink); color: #fff; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px;
    border-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.9);
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.12) inset, 0 14px 30px -24px rgba(0,0,0,0.68);
  }
  .btn-dark:hover {
    background: #0b0b0d; transform: translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.16) inset, 0 20px 38px -26px rgba(0,0,0,0.74);
  }
  .btn-dark:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.96); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.08) inset, 0 8px 18px -18px rgba(0,0,0,0.64); }
  .btn-lg.btn-dark { padding-right: 18px; }
  .btn-arrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: 0 0 auto;
    width: 1em; height: 1em; background: transparent; color: currentColor; opacity: 0.72;
    transition: opacity 0.2s var(--ease), transform 0.2s var(--ease); }
  .btn-dark:hover .btn-arrow { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(2px); }
  .btn-arrow svg { width: 0.82em; height: 0.82em; display: block; }
  .btn-lg { min-height: 46px; padding: 12px 22px; font-size: 15px; }

  /* ── Header + fixed chrome ── */
  .site-header {
    position: relative; z-index: 200;
    width: min(100%, var(--maxw)); padding-inline: var(--page-pad);
    margin: 26px auto -66px;
    display: flex; align-items: center;
  }
  .brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; }
  /* the portal's .glass-tile-accent recipe, verbatim (app/src/styles/glass.css) */
  .brand-logo {
    display: grid; place-items: center; width: 38px; aspect-ratio: 1; line-height: 0;
    position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: 29.5%; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
    background:
      linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.34), rgba(255,255,255,0.08) 46%, rgba(74,99,212,0.34)),
      var(--accent);
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.68),
      inset 0 -10px 20px rgba(74, 99, 212, 0.34),
      inset 0 -1.5px 0 rgba(74, 99, 212, 0.4),
      0 2px 6px rgba(74, 99, 212, 0.3),
      0 14px 34px -8px rgba(74, 99, 212, 0.45);
  }
  .brand-logo::before {
    content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 1px; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit;
    background:
      radial-gradient(84% 130% at 20% 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.36), transparent 40%),
      linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.22), transparent 40%, rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 72%, transparent);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .brand-logo img { display: block; width: 61.4%; height: auto;
    filter: brightness(0) drop-shadow(0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.4)) drop-shadow(0 1.5px 3px rgba(35,52,126,0.45)); }
  .brand-wordmark { font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 420; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0; }

  .chrome {
    position: fixed; top: 20px; right: clamp(16px, 2.6vw, 40px); z-index: 300;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  }
  /* Latest-post announcement pill — filled at build time from news/posts */
  .news-pill {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; max-width: 100%;
    min-height: 42px; padding: 5px 16px; border-radius: var(--r-pill);
    border: 1px solid rgba(17,17,17,0.10);
    font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    color: var(--ink-soft); text-decoration: none;
    transition: transform 0.25s var(--ease), color 0.18s var(--ease);
  }
  .news-pill:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); color: var(--ink); }
  .news-pill-tag { font-weight: 650; color: var(--accent-deep); }
  .news-pill-title { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .news-pill-arrow { transition: transform 0.18s var(--ease); }
  .news-pill:hover .news-pill-arrow { transform: translateX(2px); }
  a.news-pill.lang-fi { display: none; }
  html[lang="fi"] a.news-pill.lang-fi { display: inline-flex; }
  .lang-switch {
    position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
    padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: var(--r-pill);
    border: 1px solid rgba(17,17,17,0.10);
    transition: transform 0.25s var(--ease);
  }
  .lang-switch:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }
  /* liquid-glass thumb glides under the active language */
  .lang-switch::before {
    content: ''; position: absolute; top: 5px; bottom: 5px; left: 8px; width: 34px;
    border-radius: 9px;
    background:
      radial-gradient(120% 90% at 25% 12%, rgba(255,255,255,0.95), rgba(255,255,255,0.35) 70%),
      rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.95),
      inset 0 -3px 6px rgba(17,17,17,0.06),
      0 2px 6px -2px rgba(17,17,17,0.28);
    transition: transform 0.4s var(--spring);
  }
  html[lang="fi"] .lang-switch::before { transform: translateX(38px); }
  .lang-switch button {
    appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none; border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer;
    position: relative; z-index: 1;
    font: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; line-height: 1;
    color: var(--ink); min-width: 34px; min-height: 30px; padding: 0; border-radius: var(--r-pill);
    transition: color 0.18s var(--ease), transform 0.18s var(--ease);
  }
  .lang-switch button:active { transform: scale(0.92); }
  html[lang="en"] .lang-switch [data-lang="en"],
  html[lang="fi"] .lang-switch [data-lang="fi"] { font-weight: 750; }

  /* ── The spine: Björn's travel axis. Invisible — it exists for layout
     (railX) only; the one visible piece of it is .stage-rail in the
     constellation, between Björn and the balance scale. ── */
  .ledger-flow { position: relative; }
  .spine {
    position: absolute; z-index: 0; top: 0; left: var(--rail-x);
    width: 1px; height: 100%;
  }
  .spine-face {
    position: absolute; z-index: 40; top: 0; left: var(--rail-x);
    width: 68px; height: 68px; margin-top: 0;
    transform: translate(-50%, 120px) translateY(-50%);
    display: grid; place-items: center;
    will-change: transform; pointer-events: none;
  }
  /* The traveling mark is the app's brand tile: periwinkle liquid glass,
     black face embossed on it. The tile itself rolls along the spine (the
     old frame mechanic); the face stays upright above it. */
  /* portal tile shading; base + outer shadows here, the directional light
     lives on .frame-light, counter-rotated by JS so it always falls from
     the upper left while the tile rolls */
  .face-frame {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 29.5%; overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
    background: var(--accent);
    box-shadow:
      0 2px 6px rgba(74, 99, 212, 0.3),
      0 14px 34px -8px rgba(74, 99, 212, 0.45);
    will-change: transform;
  }
  .frame-light {
    position: absolute; inset: -22%; pointer-events: none; will-change: transform;
    background:
      radial-gradient(60% 90% at 32% 16%, rgba(255,255,255,0.36), transparent 42%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.34), rgba(255,255,255,0.08) 46%, rgba(74,99,212,0.34)),
      linear-gradient(to top, rgba(74,99,212,0.4) 4%, rgba(74,99,212,0) 30%);
  }
  .face-core {
    position: relative; width: 61.4%; line-height: 0;
    --face-bg: var(--paper); --face-filter: brightness(0);
    /* portal emboss (scaled 44→68px), computed ONCE for the assembled face —
       after masks, clips and per-frame part transforms — so moving parts can
       never reveal halo seams at the hole edges */
    filter: drop-shadow(0 1.5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.4)) drop-shadow(0 2.3px 4.6px rgba(35,52,126,0.45));
    will-change: transform;
  }
  /* On glass there is no solid --face-bg to erase with: the base image has
     its eyes + brow cut out via an alpha mask; the animated clip-path copies
     draw them back on top. */
  .face-core > img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto;
    filter: var(--face-filter);
    -webkit-mask-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 744 522'><path fill-rule='evenodd' d='M0 0H744V522H0Z M110.1 282.1a85.6 79.6 0 1 0 171.2 0a85.6 79.6 0 1 0 -171.2 0Z M559.5 305.9a58.4 54.3 0 1 0 116.8 0a58.4 54.3 0 1 0 -116.8 0Z M37.9 24H343.7V190H37.9Z M404 90H712V250H404Z'/></svg>");
    mask-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 744 522'><path fill-rule='evenodd' d='M0 0H744V522H0Z M110.1 282.1a85.6 79.6 0 1 0 171.2 0a85.6 79.6 0 1 0 -171.2 0Z M559.5 305.9a58.4 54.3 0 1 0 116.8 0a58.4 54.3 0 1 0 -116.8 0Z M37.9 24H343.7V190H37.9Z M404 90H712V250H404Z'/></svg>");
    -webkit-mask-size: 100% 100%; mask-size: 100% 100%; }
  .face-core .brow-erase, .face-core .face-eye-erase { display: none; }
  .brow-erase { position: absolute; z-index: 2; left: 5.1%; top: 4.6%; width: 41.1%; height: 31.8%; background: var(--face-bg); }
  .brow-lift  { position: absolute; z-index: 3; inset: 0; background: url(/brand/face-only.png) center/100% 100% no-repeat;
    filter: var(--face-filter);
    clip-path: inset(2.68% 53.5% 61.69% 3.76%); }
  /* right brow: the curl's stroke continues into the nose below, so it
     stretches about the cut line instead of sliding — nothing tears */
  .brow-lift.brow-right {
    clip-path: inset(17.2% 4.3% 52.1% 54.3%);
    transform-origin: 75% 47.9%;
  }
  .face-eye-erase { position: absolute; z-index: 4; background: var(--face-bg); border-radius: 50%; }
  .face-eye-erase.left  { left: 14.8%; top: 38.8%; width: 23%;   height: 30.5%; }
  .face-eye-erase.right { left: 75.2%; top: 48.2%; width: 15.7%; height: 20.8%; }
  .face-gaze { position: absolute; z-index: 5; inset: 0; will-change: transform; }
  .face-eye { position: absolute; z-index: 5; inset: 0; background: url(/brand/face-only.png) center/100% 100% no-repeat;
    filter: var(--face-filter); }
  .face-eye.left  { clip-path: inset(38.5% 61.8% 30.5% 14.2%); transform-origin: 26.2% 54%; }
  .face-eye.right { clip-path: inset(46.8% 8%   30.2% 73.8%); transform-origin: 82.9% 58.3%; }

  /* ── Postings ── */
  .posting { position: relative; margin-top: clamp(110px, 15vh, 190px); }
  .post-title {
    margin: clamp(30px, 4.5vh, 44px) auto 0; max-width: 880px; text-align: center;
    font-family: var(--font-serif);
    font-size: clamp(33px, 3.8vw, 56px); font-weight: 560; line-height: 1.06;
    letter-spacing: -0.022em; color: var(--ink); text-wrap: balance;
  }
  .post-lede {
    margin: 20px auto 0; max-width: 42em; text-align: center;
    font-size: clamp(15.5px, 1.25vw, 17.5px); line-height: 1.6; color: var(--ink-soft);
    padding-inline: 8px;

  .stage-rail { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 47%; bottom: 15%; width: 1px; background: var(--line); }

/* ── Function scenery: layered 3D terrain sheets + ribbons in depth.

  var W = 0, H = 0, sheets = [], ribbons = [];
  // depth order, far → near: three big planes, not many small ones — cheaper
  // and more scenery-like

    { band: 0.16, rw: 1.1,  alpha: 0.20, para: 0.05, dot: 1.1, tilt: 0.30, amp: 0.40 },
    { band: 0.52, rw: 1.3,  alpha: 0.25, para: 0.12, dot: 1.3, tilt: 0.40, amp: 0.46 },
    { band: 0.88, rw: 1.55, alpha: 0.27, para: 0.20, dot: 1.5, tilt: 0.50, amp: 0.52 }
  ];
  function makeSheet(conf) {
    return {
      conf: conf,
      band: conf.band + rnd(-0.05, 0.05),
      R: conf.rw * W,
      spr: glyph(3.5 + conf.dot * 2.6),
      nu: Math.min(110, Math.max(70, Math.round(W / 13))),
      nv: 30,
      f1: rnd(1.6, 3.4), g1: rnd(1.2, 2.6),
      f2: rnd(3.4, 6.2), g2: rnd(1.8, 3.6),
      f3: rnd(1.4, 2.6),

<script>
  // Language switcher: flip html[lang], persist the choice, reflect aria-pressed.
  // Detection on load already ran in <head>; this only handles user clicks.
  (function () {
    var sw = document.querySelector('.lang-switch');
    if (!sw) return;
    var btns = sw.querySelectorAll('button[data-lang]');
    function sync() {
      var cur = document.documentElement.lang === 'fi' ? 'fi' : 'en';
      btns.forEach(function (b) { b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b.dataset.lang === cur)); });
    }
    sw.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var b = e.target.closest('button[data-lang]');
      if (!b) return;
      var lang = b.dataset.lang === 'fi' ? 'fi' : 'en';
      if (window.__setLang) window.__setLang(lang);
      else {
        document.documentElement.lang = lang;
        try { localStorage.setItem('lac-lang', lang); } catch (err) {}
      }
      sync();
    });
    sync();
  })();
</script>
